records.Name: Employer Hub for an education provider
records.Challenge__c: Several departments at an education provider worked with the same employer partners, each from its own inbox and spreadsheet. Partners repeated themselves, and nobody could see the whole relationship. Leadership had no shared numbers for engagement, sponsorship or hiring.
records.Solution__c: A working Employer Hub demo built on Salesforce. Every inquiry is captured once from a web form, matched to the partner's account and routed by academic focus area. Service requests are fulfilled from the case, and monetary requests run through an opportunity to a contract. Operations and executive dashboards report from the same records.
records.Business_Value__c: Designed so that employer partners get one front door and a faster answer, departments stop duplicating outreach and see each other's work with a partner, and leadership can report on the employer relationship as a whole.
